meta.node_id_convention_summary: farm_manager is the legacy module. Two granularities, BOTH already present in the graph before this run, are used and no third is introduced: (1) one per-file anchor node `farm_manager.model.<MainClass>` (node_type pydantic_model) - this is the id form the sibling map_farm_api / map_farm_services / map_plant_library batches already point their edges at, so all 14 pre-existing anchors are UPDATED in place, never duplicated; (2) per-class nodes `farm_manager.models.<file>.<Class>` (node_type db_model) for enums, for secondary persisted document models in multi-entity files, and for significant embedded sub-models - the same file-qualified form the 14 pre-existing farm_manager.models.farm_task.* nodes use. The file-qualified form is required because PascalCase class names collide across this module (AlertSeverity/AlertStatus in both alert.py and block_alert.py; QualityGrade in block_harvest.py, inventory.py and plant_data_enhanced.py; HarvestEntry in farm_task.py and harvest.py). Pure create/update/list-response DTOs are not given nodes; they are listed in their anchor's `exports`. Collections are collection_<snake>.

nodes.name: farms
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: farms - farm documents (farmId unique, managerId, isActive). Persists models/farm.py Farm.

nodes.name: blocks
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: blocks - physical and virtual growing blocks with the status state machine. Persists models/block.py Block. Indexed on blockId (unique), farmId, state, currentPlanting, currentCycleId, estimatedHarvestDate and (Plant Library Phase 1) productMotherId.

nodes.name: block_archives
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: block_archives - completed growing cycles archived at cleaning->empty. Persists models/block_archive.py BlockArchive, including the Phase 1 productMotherId/productName mother (product/SKU) rollup copied from the block.

nodes.name: block_cycles
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: block_cycles - one planting-to-harvest sequence per block; source for historical analytics/AI training. Persists models/block_cycle.py BlockCycle.

nodes.name: block_harvests
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: block_harvests - the SELLABLE harvest ledger ONLY (Plant Library product extension Stage 3, design doc §3.1: process/waste lines must never become rows here). Persists models/block_harvest.py BlockHarvest. Stage 3 added optional productId, productName (FROZEN snapshot, never re-synced on rename) and harvestBatchId, all indexed; ~13,947 legacy rows keep nulls and are not backfilled.

nodes.name: block_alerts
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: block_alerts - per-block alerts with severity/status/category and threaded comments. Persists models/block_alert.py BlockAlert.

nodes.name: block_history
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: block_history - full block lifecycle snapshots written on the cleaning->empty transition. Persists models/block_history.py BlockHistoryArchive.

nodes.name: alerts
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: alerts - cycle/block/farm level alerts with severity, status, escalation. Persists models/alert.py Alert.

nodes.name: daily_harvests
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: daily_harvests - individual daily harvest entries per cycle/planting/block. Persists models/daily_harvest.py DailyHarvest.

nodes.name: harvests
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: harvests - aggregated final harvest summaries (legacy model kept for reporting/back-compat). Persists models/harvest.py Harvest.

nodes.name: plantings
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: plantings - planting plans with block assignments. Persists models/planting.py Planting.

nodes.name: plant_data
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: plant_data - simple/legacy plant catalog. Persists models/plant_data.py PlantData.

nodes.name: plant_data_enhanced
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: plant_data_enhanced - the VARIETY level of the two-level Plant Library (cultivation recipe: growth cycle, fertigation, environment, spacing, yield). Persists models/plant_data_enhanced.py PlantDataEnhanced; motherPlantId (indexed) + varietyName link each row up to its PlantMother.

nodes.name: plant_mothers
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: plant_mothers - the MOTHER (product/SKU) level of the Plant Library; harvest/inventory/sales roll up here. Persists models/plant_mother.py PlantMother. Product extension Stage 1 embedded a products[] picklist of PlantProduct (productId/name/unit/category), indexed on products.productId; deletion is deactivation only.

nodes.name: farm_assignments
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: farm_assignments - maps users to farms for access control. Persists models/farm_assignment.py FarmAssignment.

nodes.name: farm_tasks
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: farm_tasks - operations task manager for farming activities. Persists models/farm_task.py FarmTask (taskData.harvestEntries, totalHarvest, status, division/organization scoping).

nodes.name: stock_inventory
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: stock_inventory - farm stock/harvest inventory for FIFO tracking. Persists models/stock_inventory.py StockInventoryItem.

nodes.name: products
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: products - master product catalog for inventory (organization-wide). Persists models/inventory.py Product. Distinct from PlantMother.products[] (the Plant Library per-mother picklist), which is embedded, not a collection.

nodes.name: inventory_harvest
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: inventory_harvest - SELLABLE harvest stock only, with quality grade, reservation and FIFO fields. Persists models/inventory.py HarvestInventory.

nodes.name: inventory_input
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: inventory_input - farm input supplies (fertilizer, pesticide, seed, soil...) with base-unit normalization and low-stock flags. Persists models/inventory.py InputInventory.

nodes.name: inventory_asset
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: inventory_asset - farm equipment/assets with status, allocation and maintenance tracking. Persists models/inventory.py AssetInventory.

nodes.name: inventory_movements
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: inventory_movements - append-only ledger of additions, removals, adjustments, transfers, sales, waste, reservations and shipments. Persists models/inventory.py InventoryMovement.

nodes.name: processing_inventory
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: processing_inventory - NEW (Plant Library product extension Stage 3, design doc §4.4). Destination for `process`-category harvest lines, deliberately separate from inventory_harvest which stays sellable-only. Persists models/inventory.py ProcessingInventory. Graded (A/B/C) but has no reservation/FIFO machinery. Indexed on inventoryId (unique), organizationId, farmId, blockId, productId, harvestBatchId, harvestDate, createdAt.

nodes.name: inventory_waste
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: inventory_waste - waste ledger. Persists models/inventory.py WasteInventory. Pre-existing write paths (returns, expired, damaged, order deletion) are unchanged; Stage 3 added optional productId + harvestBatchId for waste-category harvest lines routed straight here from POST .../harvests/batch, plus indexes on harvestBatchId and sourceBlockId for the batch-lookup endpoint.

nodes.name: inventory_returned
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: inventory_returned - goods returned by customers (customer-origin, unlike farm-origin inventory_harvest). Persists models/inventory.py ReturnedInventory.

nodes.name: system_config
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: system_config - singleton config documents; holds the farming year config (models/farming_year_config.py FarmingYearConfig) and the plant spacing standards (models/spacing_standards.py SpacingStandardsConfig).

nodes.name: weather_cache
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: weather_cache - caches WeatherBit API responses. Persists models/weather.py WeatherCacheEntry.

nodes.name: deleted_farms
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: deleted_farms - farms moved here on delete so the live collections stay clean for AI analytics. Persists models/deleted_archives.py DeletedFarm.

nodes.name: deleted_blocks
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: deleted_blocks - blocks preserved on cascade delete. Persists models/deleted_archives.py DeletedBlock.

nodes.name: deleted_block_archives
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: deleted_block_archives - block archives preserved on cascade delete. Persists models/deleted_archives.py DeletedBlockArchive.

nodes.name: deleted_block_harvests
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: deleted_block_harvests - harvest rows preserved on cascade delete. Persists models/deleted_archives.py DeletedBlockHarvest.

nodes.name: fertilizer_chemicals
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: fertilizer_chemicals - master chemical catalog for the Fertilizer Cost Calculator (canonical name, aliases, category, pricing unit; soft-deleted via archivedAt). Persists models/tools/fertilizer_chemical.py FertilizerChemical.

nodes.name: fertilizer_price_overrides
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: fertilizer_price_overrides - per-organization price per chemical (unique on chemicalId+organizationId). Persists models/tools/fertilizer_price.py PriceOverride.

nodes.name: fertilizer_calculation_lists
nodes.description: MongoDB collection: fertilizer_calculation_lists - saved fertilizer calculation lists per organization. Persists models/tools/calculation_list.py CalculationList.

nodes.name: Farm
nodes.description: farm.py - Farm document model (farmId, location, GeoJSON boundary, manager, metadata) plus its create/update schemas. Persists to the farms collection.

nodes.name: Block
nodes.description: block.py - Block document model: status lifecycle (BlockStatus), physical vs virtual blocks, IoT/SenseHub controller, KPI + historical KPI, plant-data snapshot, multi-crop virtual planting. targetCrop stays the VARIETY (plant_data_enhanced); Plant Library Phase 1 added productMotherId + productName (line 409) carrying the MOTHER product/SKU, stamped at planting and indexed. Persists to the blocks collection.

nodes.name: BlockArchive
nodes.description: block_archive.py - Archive record for a completed block cycle: yield totals, QualityBreakdown, AlertsSummary, farming years planted/harvested. Carries productMotherId + productName (line 66, Plant Library Phase 1, optional - pre-migration archives leave them unset) so archived cycles roll up to the same product as the live block did. Persists to the block_archives collection.

nodes.name: BlockHarvest
nodes.description: block_harvest.py - Harvest event model for the SELLABLE ledger. Stage 3 of the Plant Library product extension added optional productId, productName (FROZEN name snapshot, never re-synced) and harvestBatchId to BlockHarvest, plus the multi-line batch submission models (HarvestBatchLineCreate/SubmitRequest/LineResult/SubmitResponse, lines 187-247) and the batch-lookup models (HarvestBatchLookupLine/Group/LookupResponse, lines 250-276) that union the three destinations. Persists to the block_harvests collection.

nodes.name: BlockAlert
nodes.description: block_alert.py - Per-block alert model with severity, status, category and threaded AlertComment list. Note: defines its own AlertSeverity/AlertStatus, distinct from alert.py's. Persists to the block_alerts collection.

nodes.name: Alert
nodes.description: alert.py - Cycle/block/farm level alert model with severity, status, type, escalation and resolution. Persists to the alerts collection.

nodes.name: BlockCycle
nodes.description: block_cycle.py - One complete planting-to-harvest sequence for a block, with embedded alert and daily-harvest summaries. The primary source for historical analytics and AI training. Persists to the block_cycles collection.

nodes.name: BlockHistoryArchive
nodes.description: block_history.py - Complete snapshot of a block's lifecycle from planting to completion, written on the CLEANING -> EMPTY transition. Reuses BlockStatus/BlockType/BlockLocation/BlockKPI/StatusChange from block.py. Persists to the block_history collection.

nodes.name: DailyHarvest
nodes.description: daily_harvest.py - Individual daily harvest record for a cycle/planting/block, with per-grade DailyHarvestEntry lines. Persists to the daily_harvests collection.

nodes.name: Harvest
nodes.description: harvest.py - Final aggregated harvest summary rolled up from daily harvests. Legacy model kept for backward compatibility and reporting. Persists to the harvests collection.

nodes.name: Planting
nodes.description: planting.py - Planting plan assigning one or more PlantingItem crop lines to a block. Persists to the plantings collection.

nodes.name: PlantData
nodes.description: plant_data.py - Simple/legacy plant catalog model with DataContributor attribution. Superseded by plant_data_enhanced.py for new work. Persists to the plant_data collection.

nodes.name: PlantDataEnhanced
nodes.description: plant_data_enhanced.py - The VARIETY level of the two-level Plant Library: the full cultivation recipe (growth cycle, yield, environment, watering, soil, light, spacing, economics, fertigation cards/rules/schedules). Variety-aware since Phase 1: motherPlantId + varietyName (lines 631-672) link each row to its PlantMother. Persists to the plant_data_enhanced collection.

nodes.name: PlantMother
nodes.description: plant_mother.py - The MOTHER (product/SKU) level of the Plant Library; harvest, inventory and sales roll up here rather than to individual varieties. Product extension Stage 1 added the per-mother products[] picklist (PlantProduct, line 115) with routing category sellable | process | waste, embedded rather than a separate collection because products are meaningless outside their mother. Also carries the Phase 2 composite response shapes. Persists to the plant_mothers collection.

nodes.name: FarmAssignment
nodes.description: farm_assignment.py - Maps a user to a farm for access control (assignmentId, userId, farmId, isActive). Persists to the farm_assignments collection.

nodes.name: FarmTask
nodes.description: farm_task.py - Operations task model: type, priority, status, assignment, and taskData carrying harvest entries + rolled-up totals. FarmTaskWithDetails adds joined block/farm context for the task UI. Persists to the farm_tasks collection. Per-class nodes for this file live under the farm_manager.models.farm_task.* namespace.

nodes.name: FarmingYearConfig
nodes.description: farming_year_config.py - Per-organization farming year definition (default start month = August) plus the get_farming_year / get_farming_year_date_range helpers used to stamp farmingYear on harvests and archives. Stored as a singleton document in the system_config collection.

nodes.name: SpacingStandardsConfig
nodes.description: spacing_standards.py - Plant spacing standards: per-SpacingCategory densities (plants per 100 sqm) plus the plant-count / area conversion helpers used by block planting and plant_data. Stored as a singleton document in the system_config collection.

nodes.name: StockInventoryItem
nodes.description: stock_inventory.py - FIFO stock/harvest inventory line keyed by farm, plant, block, cycle and daily harvest with a quality grade. Persists to the stock_inventory collection.

nodes.name: Inventory models
nodes.description: inventory.py - The farm inventory model file (1528 lines). Holds EIGHT separately persisted document models, each with its own collection: Product (products), HarvestInventory (inventory_harvest), InputInventory (inventory_input), AssetInventory (inventory_asset), InventoryMovement (inventory_movements), ProcessingInventory (processing_inventory, NEW), WasteInventory (inventory_waste) and ReturnedInventory (inventory_returned) - see the farm_manager.models.inventory.* nodes. Also holds the unit-conversion tables (MASS_TO_MG, VOLUME_TO_ML, COUNT_TO_UNIT, CATEGORY_BASE_UNIT) and helpers that normalize input quantities to a base unit.

nodes.name: Weather models
nodes.description: weather.py - WeatherBit-derived models: current conditions (with solar, air quality and soil sub-models), agricultural forecast days, agronomic insights, and the WeatherCacheEntry envelope that is the only persisted model here (weather_cache collection).

nodes.name: Deleted archive models
nodes.description: deleted_archives.py - Tombstone models written by the cascade deletion service. Deleting a farm or block moves its documents into parallel deleted_* collections so the live collections stay clean for AI analytics while history is preserved. Four models, four collections.

nodes.name: DashboardSummary
nodes.description: dashboard.py - Read-only dashboard response models (no collection of their own): block/farm summaries, blocks-by-state counts, harvest rollups, yield KPIs, crop breakdown and farming-year context. Composed from blocks, block_harvests, block_alerts and farms at query time.

nodes.name: BlockAnalyticsResponse
nodes.description: block_analytics.py - Read-only per-block analytics response models (no collection of their own): yield trend, state timeline, task stats, performance metrics and alert analytics, aggregated over block_harvests, farm_tasks and block_alerts.

nodes.name: FarmAnalyticsResponse
nodes.description: farm_analytics.py - Read-only farm-level analytics response models (no collection of their own): aggregated metrics, block state breakdown, block comparison, yield timeline and historical trends.

nodes.name: GlobalAnalyticsResponse
nodes.description: global_analytics.py - Read-only cross-farm analytics response models (no collection of their own): per-farm summaries, global aggregated metrics, state breakdown, yield timeline and performance insights.

nodes.name: FertilizerChemical
nodes.description: tools/fertilizer_chemical.py - Master chemical catalog for the Fertilizer Cost Calculator: canonical name, aliases, IngredientCategoryEnum category and default pricing unit (kg or L). Soft-deleted via archivedAt. Persists to the fertilizer_chemicals collection.

nodes.name: PriceOverride
nodes.description: tools/fertilizer_price.py - Per-organization price override for a chemical, plus the ResolvedPrice value object returned after applying the price book. Persists to the fertilizer_price_overrides collection (unique on chemicalId + organizationId).

nodes.name: CalculationList
nodes.description: tools/calculation_list.py - A saved fertilizer calculation list (crop/area line items) scoped to an organization. Persists to the fertilizer_calculation_lists collection.

nodes.name: Fertilizer calculator DTOs
nodes.description: tools/calculator_request.py - Request/response DTOs for the Fertilizer Cost Calculator (no collection of their own): the calculate request lines, per-ingredient and per-crop results, and the spreadsheet-import parse result with skipped rows.

nodes.name: BlockStatus
nodes.description: Enum: the block state machine - empty, planting, growing, harvesting, cleaning, maintenance, inactive. Drives task generation and dashboard blocks-by-state counts.

nodes.name: BlockType
nodes.description: Enum: block type - greenhouse, open_field, hydroponic, nursery, vertical_farm, virtual (a virtual crop inside a physical block).

nodes.name: PerformanceCategory
nodes.description: Enum: KPI performance banding used by BlockKPI - excellent, good, average, poor.

nodes.name: BlockKPI
nodes.description: Embedded KPI block on Block: expected vs actual yield, yield variance, cycle duration and a PerformanceCategory rating.

nodes.name: HistoricalKPI
nodes.description: Embedded on physical Blocks only: KPIs aggregated across completed virtual-block cycles.

nodes.name: IoTController
nodes.description: Embedded IoT/SenseHub controller config on Block, including SenseHubCredentials and last-sync/staleness fields (surfaced by BlockWithStaleness).

nodes.name: StatusChange
nodes.description: Embedded status-transition record appended to Block.statusHistory; reused by block_archive.py and block_history.py.

nodes.name: PlantDataSnapshot
nodes.description: Embedded frozen copy of the planted variety's cultivation data, taken at planting so a later plant_data_enhanced edit does not rewrite a running cycle.

nodes.name: QualityGrade
nodes.description: Enum: A | B | C harvest quality scale. The canonical harvest grade - inventory.py imports it as HarvestQualityGrade for ProcessingInventory so one grade picklist works for both sellable and process lines. Distinct from inventory.py's own six-value QualityGrade.

nodes.name: HarvestMetadata
nodes.description: Embedded free-form metadata on BlockHarvest carrying migration provenance (migratedFrom/At, oldRef, legacyBlockCode, season). Config.extra = allow.

nodes.name: HarvestBatchSubmitRequest
nodes.description: Request body for POST .../harvests/batch: one harvestDate plus >=1 HarvestBatchLineCreate product lines. The server generates one shared harvestBatchId and routes each line by its product category.

nodes.name: HarvestBatchSubmitResponse
nodes.description: Response for a completed multi-line harvest submission: the harvestBatchId plus a HarvestBatchLineResult per line recording category, destination collection (block_harvests | processing_inventory | inventory_waste) and the created recordId.

nodes.name: HarvestBatchLookupResponse
nodes.description: Response for GET .../harvests/batch-lookup: given a block + harvest date, unions all three destinations into HarvestBatchGroup/HarvestBatchLookupLine so a mixed submission can be reviewed as a unit. The default harvest list stays block_harvests-only.

nodes.name: BlockHarvestSummary
nodes.description: Per-block harvest rollup: total harvests, total kg, per-grade kg (A/B/C), average grade, first/last harvest date. Computed, not stored.

nodes.name: QualityBreakdown
nodes.description: Embedded per-grade kg breakdown on BlockArchive.

nodes.name: AlertsSummary
nodes.description: Embedded alert counts (total, by severity, resolved) on BlockArchive.

nodes.name: ProductUnit
nodes.description: Enum: unit of measure for a PlantProduct. kg is the only member today - deliberately an enum so a future animal-husbandry module can add head/litre without backfilling existing harvest rows.

nodes.name: ProductCategory
nodes.description: Enum: sellable | process | waste. Fixed vocabulary, no user-created categories. Governs harvest-line routing: sellable -> block_harvests, process -> processing_inventory, waste -> inventory_waste. Sellable is the ONLY category that may ever produce a block_harvests row.

nodes.name: PlantProduct
nodes.description: A concrete product a mother yields (e.g. Capsicum -> Green Capsicum / Capsicum Puree / Capsicum Trim). EMBEDDED in PlantMother.products[], not its own collection. Stable productId (UUID, never reused), name unique within the mother, ProductUnit, ProductCategory, isActive. Deletion is deactivation only - never removed from the array - so harvest rows referencing productId need no migration.

nodes.name: PlantMotherWithVarieties
nodes.description: Composite response for GET /plant-mothers/{id}: PlantMother plus its active varieties as lightweight VarietySummary entries. PlantMotherWithVarietyCount is the list-endpoint counterpart (varietyCount computed by the repository, not stored).

nodes.name: VarietyCreateForMother
nodes.description: Request body for POST /plant-mothers/{motherPlantId}/varieties. Extends PlantDataEnhancedBase; plantName/scientificName are inherited from the mother and ignored, varietyName is the one new required field (unique per mother).

nodes.name: Product
nodes.description: Master product catalog entry, organization-wide. Persists to the products collection. NOT the same thing as PlantMother.products[] / PlantProduct, which is the embedded Plant Library picklist.

nodes.name: HarvestInventory
nodes.description: Sellable harvest stock item: quality grade, quantities with reservation/available split for FIFO order fulfilment, expiry and source block/plant links. Persists to the inventory_harvest collection.

nodes.name: InputInventory
nodes.description: Farm input supply item (fertilizer, pesticide, seed, soil...) with InputCategory, base-unit normalized quantity and low-stock flagging. Persists to the inventory_input collection.

nodes.name: AssetInventory
nodes.description: Farm equipment/asset record with AssetCategory, AssetStatus, current allocation and maintenance schedule/overdue flag. Persists to the inventory_asset collection.

nodes.name: InventoryMovement
nodes.description: Append-only movement ledger entry recording every quantity change against any inventory type, typed by MovementType (addition, removal, adjustment, transfer, sale, waste, usage, return, restoration, reservation, shipment). Persists to the inventory_movements collection.

nodes.name: ProcessingInventory
nodes.description: NEW (Plant Library product extension Stage 3, design doc §4.4). Destination record for a `process`-category harvest line: productId + FROZEN productName snapshot, quantity/unit, an A/B/C qualityGrade (process output IS graded, unlike waste), harvestDate and the shared harvestBatchId. Deliberately kept out of inventory_harvest, which stays sellable-only, and given no reservation/availability/FIFO fields (out of scope until process output is sold directly). Persists to the processing_inventory collection.

nodes.name: WasteInventory
nodes.description: Waste ledger entry with WasteSourceType provenance (harvest, return, expired, damaged, quality_reject, order_deletion), DisposalMethod, estimated value and source links. Stage 3 added optional productId + harvestBatchId, populated only for waste lines routed straight here by the multi-line harvest submission; the pre-existing write paths leave both null. Harvest waste is NOT graded - a waste line supplying a qualityGrade is rejected 422. Persists to the inventory_waste collection.

nodes.name: ReturnedInventory
nodes.description: Goods returned by a customer (customer-origin, unlike farm-origin HarvestInventory), tracked for re-stock or write-off. Persists to the inventory_returned collection.

nodes.name: TransferRecord
nodes.description: Record of an inventory transfer between farms/scopes, produced by a TransferRequest and mirrored into inventory_movements as MovementType.TRANSFER.

nodes.name: InventoryScope
nodes.description: Enum: organization (default inventory, farmId null) | farm (farm-specific). Indexed on all three inventory collections.

nodes.name: InventoryType
nodes.description: Enum: harvest | input | asset - the three main inventory categories, each with its own collection.

nodes.name: HarvestProductType
nodes.description: Enum: fresh, processed, dried, frozen, packaged - the form a harvest inventory item is held in.

nodes.name: InputCategory
nodes.description: Enum: fertilizer, pesticide, herbicide, fungicide, seed, seedling, soil, substrate and related input classes. Each category maps to a BaseUnit via CATEGORY_BASE_UNIT.

nodes.name: BaseUnit
nodes.description: Enum: the canonical storage unit an input quantity is normalized to (mg / ml / unit family). Together with MASS_TO_MG, VOLUME_TO_ML and COUNT_TO_UNIT it makes quantities comparable regardless of the unit the user entered.

nodes.name: DisplayUnit
nodes.description: Enum: the unit a normalized base quantity is rendered back into for display (kg, g, L, ml, unit...).

nodes.name: AssetCategory
nodes.description: Enum: tractor, harvester, irrigation_system, greenhouse, storage_facility, vehicle, tool, equipment, infrastructure, sensor, other.

nodes.name: AssetStatus
nodes.description: Enum: operational, maintenance, repair, decommissioned, stored.

nodes.name: QualityGrade
nodes.description: Enum: premium, grade_a, grade_b, grade_c, processing, rejected - the SIX-value inventory grade scale. Distinct from block_harvest.py's three-value A/B/C QualityGrade, which is what harvest and processing lines use.

nodes.name: MovementType
nodes.description: Enum: addition, removal, adjustment, transfer, sale, waste, usage, return, restoration (reviving an expired batch), reservation (stock held for a confirmed order), shipment (stock leaves on ship).

nodes.name: WasteSourceType
nodes.description: Enum: harvest, return, expired, damaged, quality_reject, other, order_deletion. Harvest-sourced waste is what the Stage 3 batch routing writes.

nodes.name: DisposalMethod
nodes.description: Enum: compost, animal_feed, discard, sold_discount, donated, pending.

nodes.name: WeatherCacheEntry
nodes.description: Cache envelope wrapping a WeatherBit response with its location key and TTL - the only persisted model in weather.py. Persists to the weather_cache collection.

nodes.name: CurrentWeather
nodes.description: Current conditions for a farm location, embedding SolarData, AirQuality and SoilConditions. Response-only.

nodes.name: AgriWeatherData
nodes.description: Combined agricultural weather payload: current conditions, AgriWeatherForecast days and derived AgriculturalInsights. Response-only.

nodes.name: DeletedBlock
nodes.description: Tombstone copy of a deleted block. Persists to the deleted_blocks collection.

nodes.name: DeletedBlockArchive
nodes.description: Tombstone copy of a deleted block archive. Persists to the deleted_block_archives collection.

nodes.name: DeletedBlockHarvest
nodes.description: Tombstone copy of a deleted harvest row. Persists to the deleted_block_harvests collection.

nodes.name: AlertSeverity
nodes.description: Enum (alert.py): info, warning, critical. Reused by block_cycle.py's BlockCycleAlert. Distinct from block_alert.py's AlertSeverity.

nodes.name: AlertStatus
nodes.description: Enum (alert.py): active, acknowledged, resolved. Distinct from block_alert.py's AlertStatus.

nodes.name: AlertType
nodes.description: Enum (alert.py): the alert trigger class - overdue, yield_variance, environmental, pest_disease and related.

nodes.name: AlertSeverity
nodes.description: Enum (block_alert.py): severity scale for per-block alerts. Distinct from alert.py's AlertSeverity - both names exist in this module.

nodes.name: AlertStatus
nodes.description: Enum (block_alert.py): status lifecycle for per-block alerts.

nodes.name: AlertCategory
nodes.description: Enum (block_alert.py): alert category (pest, disease, irrigation, equipment, environmental, other) used for filtering and analytics.

nodes.name: AlertComment
nodes.description: Embedded threaded comment on a BlockAlert (author, body, timestamp).

nodes.name: FarmTypeEnum
nodes.description: Enum: which farm types a variety can be grown in (greenhouse, open_field, hydroponic, vertical...). Drives plant-library filtering by block type.

nodes.name: GrowthStageEnum
nodes.description: Enum: germination, seedling, vegetative, flowering, fruiting, harvest - the stage axis for fertigation rules and growth cycle duration.

nodes.name: ToleranceLevelEnum
nodes.description: Enum: low | medium | high tolerance rating used across environmental requirements.

nodes.name: SeverityLevelEnum
nodes.description: Enum: severity rating for a DiseaseOrPest entry.

nodes.name: LightTypeEnum
nodes.description: Enum: natural, artificial, supplemental light source for LightRequirements.

nodes.name: WaterTypeEnum
nodes.description: Enum: water source/quality class for WateringRequirements.

nodes.name: SoilTypeEnum
nodes.description: Enum: soil/substrate class for SoilRequirements.

nodes.name: GrowthHabitEnum
nodes.description: Enum: determinate, indeterminate, bush, vine and related growth habits.

nodes.name: SupportTypeEnum
nodes.description: Enum: trellis, stake, cage, none - the physical support a variety needs.

nodes.name: IngredientCategoryEnum
nodes.description: Enum: fertigation ingredient class (macro, micro, acid, base, biological...). Also imported by tools/fertilizer_chemical.py so the calculator's chemical catalog shares one vocabulary with the plant library.

nodes.name: FertigationRuleTypeEnum
nodes.description: Enum: how a FertigationRule is applied (per_stage, per_day, custom).

nodes.name: FertigationSchedule
nodes.description: The variety's full fertigation programme: FertigationCard groups of FertigationRule entries over FertigationIngredient lines, plus CustomApplication overrides.

nodes.name: GrowthCycleDuration
nodes.description: Per-stage day counts for a variety (germination through harvest) used to project estimatedHarvestDate on a block.

nodes.name: SpacingRequirements
nodes.description: Per-variety plant spacing and plants-per-100sqm, resolved against the shared SpacingCategory standards by resolve_default_plants_per_100m2.

nodes.name: YieldInfo
nodes.description: Expected yield per plant / per sqm and waste percentage for a variety - the basis for a block's expected yield KPI.

nodes.name: SpacingCategory
nodes.description: Enum: the plant spacing band (very_dense through very_sparse) that maps to a plants-per-100sqm density. Imported by both plant_data.py and plant_data_enhanced.py.

nodes.name: TimePeriod
nodes.description: Enum: the analytics rollup window (week, month, quarter, year, all).

nodes.name: TrendDirection
nodes.description: Enum: up | down | stable, used to annotate analytics trends.
